decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

1014_000_001, 1014_100_003, 1014_100_004, 1014_100_005, 1014_200_002, 1014_200_003, 1014_200_102, 1014_200_103 (Rev A), 1014_200_101 (Rev A), 1014_200_001 (Rev A), 1014_100_002 (Rev A), 1014_100_001 (Rev A),  1014_700_001 (Rev A), 1014_800_001 (Rev A), Design and Access Statement prepared by LVHA, Heritage Statement prepared by Jon Lowe Heritage.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017, and policy D3 of the Kentish Town Neighbourhood Plan 2016,
Condition : 4 - Before the relevant part of the work is begun, detailed drawings and specifications of external materials, as appropriate, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The following details are required: 
 
a. Full details and specifications of the materials proposed for the rear extension, including brickwork, stone detailing, mortar, doors and associated finishes, including colour and finish;

b.  Detailed drawings (minimum scale 1:10) and specifications of the proposed lower ground floor window and door to the front lightwell, and any associated joinery, including sections, frame dimensions, materials, finish and colour.

To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and that it preserves the character and appearance of the conservation area in accordance with policies D1 and D2 of the Camden Local Plan 2017 and policy D3 of the Kentish Town Neighbourhood Plan 2016.
Condition : 5 - The flat roof of the extension hereby approved shall not be used at any time as amenity space, and any access out onto this area shall be for maintenance purposes only. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining neighbours in accordance with the requirements of policy A1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Erection of a single-storey rear extension, repair of existing cast iron railings, replacement of window to front lower ground floor, and installation of PV panels to roof.
